---
name: markdown-export
description: "Use when: generating or exporting Markdown from any DecisionDeck record. Covers the Markdown shape for a single Decision, a full Weekly Report, a Risk, an Incident, and the JSON export format."
---

# Markdown Export

## Decision Markdown Shape

```markdown
# DEC-{id}: {title}

**Status:** {status}
**Area:** {area}
**Owner:** {owner or "unassigned"}
**Review Date:** {reviewDate or "none"}

## Context

{context}

## Decision

{decision}

## Rationale

{rationale}

## Alternatives Considered

{alternatives or "none recorded"}

## Risks

{risks or "none recorded"}

## Linked Records

- Work items: {linkedWorkItemIds.join(", ") or "none"}
- Risks: {linkedRiskIds.join(", ") or "none"}
- Incidents: {linkedIncidentIds.join(", ") or "none"}
- Supersedes: {supersedesDecisionIds.join(", ") or "none"}
- Superseded by: {supersededByDecisionId or "none"}

---
*Exported from DecisionDeck — {ISO timestamp}*
```

## Weekly Report Markdown Shape

```markdown
# Engineering Weekly Report
**Week:** {weekStart} to {weekEnd}
**Generated:** {generatedAt}

---

## Summary

{highlights}

## Needs Attention

{items that are blocked, high-risk, or overdue — each citing the source record}

## Blocked Work

{blocked work items with blockedReason}

## High-Risk Work

{work items with riskLevel: "high", each showing linked decisions or flagging their absence}

## Open Risks

{open risks with severity and likelihood}

## Incidents and Follow-ups

{incidents from this week + overdue follow-ups}

## Decisions Accepted This Week

{decisions with status "accepted" and updatedAt within the week range}

## Decisions Needing Review

{decisions with reviewDate past or status "needs_review"}

## Recommended Actions

{each recommendation must cite its evidence — linked decision ID, work item ID, or risk ID}
> Evidence: DEC-{id}: {title}

## Appendix: Linked Decisions

{full list of decision IDs and titles referenced in the report}

---
*Generated by DecisionDeck — facts and interpretations are separated above*
```

## Fact vs Interpretation Rule

Apply these markers consistently in generated reports:

- `[FACT]` — directly observed from a record field (status, date, linked ID)
- `[RECOMMENDATION]` — inferred or suggested by the system, always followed by evidence citation

Never emit a recommendation without a cited evidence record.

## JSON Export Shape

Every major object exports as clean JSON matching the TypeScript type. Use `JSON.stringify(record, null, 2)`.

## File Naming

```
decision-{id}.md
report-{weekStart}.md
decisions-export-{ISO date}.json
```
